alerts.header: Route 60: Geyserville Tractor Parade Detour Saturday, November 28th.
alerts.description:
Due to the Geyserville Tractor Parade, Geyserville Avenue will be closed between Highway 128 and Canyon Road on Saturday, November 28, 2026. Route 60 will detour in both directions from 6 PM to 8 PM.

Route 60 Northbound to Cloverdale

Buses will enter Highway 101 North from Geyserville Avenue, exit at Canyon Road, and turn left onto Geyserville Avenue to resume regular routing.

Stops not served:
- Geyserville Ave & Walden St (7706000)
- Geyserville Ave (Geyserville Park & Ride) (7706100)
- Geyserville Ave & Geysers Ridge Rd (7706200)
- Geyserville Ave & Canyon Rd (7706300)
Route 60 Southbound to Santa Rosa

Buses will turn right onto Canyon Road, enter Highway 101 South, exit at Geyserville Avenue, and turn right onto Geyserville Avenue to resume regular routing.

Stops not served:
- Geyserville Ave & Canyon Rd (7708600)
- Geyserville Ave & Geysers Ridge Rd (7708700)
- Geyserville Ave & School House Ln (7708800)
- Geyserville Ave (AC Geyserville Park & Ride) (7708810)
- Geyserville Ave & Walden St (7708900)
Regular routing and service to affected stops will resume once Geyserville Avenue reopens.
